constraints: Literal numeric/written limits, explicit ordering, named grouped measures and application-owned prior group membership. No acceptance dataset names or case IDs in constraint code.
repair_policy: One deterministic pass per candidate, followed by full structural/live semantic/request validation. At most one additional same-model request, sharing the existing two-total-attempt and remaining-time budget. Never strip invalid measure arguments or invent measures/filters/approvals.
scope: Only Local AI planning receives the new constraint reconciler. Standard retains its existing parser; saved canonical plans and parameterized DuckDB cohort execution retain their existing format.
diagnostic_policy: Opt-in byte-verified synthetic fixture only; received redacted plans captured before reconciliation; static correction keys reported separately.
